page_title: TOU 2-1 REN | Toulouse v Rennes 03/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Benoit Millot is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
90+6' A rebound bounces out to Adrien Truffert (Rennes) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
90+6' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
90+4' Toulouse have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' Ismael Kone (Rennes) tested Guillaume Restes with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
90+2' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lorenz Assignon walks off the pitch to be replaced by Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' A goal, which was scored by Joshua King (Toulouse), was disallowed due to offside.
87' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) unleashes a shot, but it just misses the left-hand post.
87' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
87' Substitution. Yann Gboho makes way for Umit Akdag (Toulouse).

82' 2 - 1 A good lofted pass from Guillaume Restes finds Aron Donnum (Toulouse) on the edge of the area. He collects the ball and rips in a wonderful shot which ends up in the bottom left corner. The score is now 2:1.
81' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) takes a shot on goal, but his effort isn't precise enough and it flies a whisker wide of the left post.
80' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
77' Substitution. Miha Zajc (Toulouse) on for Warren Kamanzi.
75' Rennes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
74' Flag goes up against Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
73' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Frank Magri is replaced by Rafik Messali (Toulouse).
72' The free kick finds Lilian Brassier (Rennes) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just wide of the left post from close range.
69' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) is flagged for offside.
68' Carles Martinez is stunned as referee Benoit Millot shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
67' Substitution. Jordan James is replaced by Azor Matusiwa (Rennes).
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Kazeem Olaigbe as he is replaced by Mousa Tamari (Rennes).

65' 1 - 1 What a goal! Adrien Truffert plays it to Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Guillaume Restes into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
58' Here is a change. Christopher Wooh is going off and Habib Beye gives the last tactical orders to Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes).
58' Today's match ends for Djaoui Cisse who will be replaced by Ismael Kone (Rennes).
58' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) fires a first-time shot. Unfortunately for him, his strike goes a few inches wide of the left post.
58' Good work from Rennes as they win a corner.
57' The corner is swung in but Rennes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

55' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Guillaume Restes shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
53' Rennes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
48' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way past the right post.
47' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) sees a yellow card from Benoit Millot after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Benoit Millot has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' The foul by Anthony Rouault (Rennes) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Benoit Millot.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Jordan James (Rennes) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
45' What a save from Guillaume Restes! Mohamed Meite (Rennes) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
42' Toulouse work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
40' Frank Magri (Toulouse) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
38' Looks like Frank Magri (Toulouse) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
37' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
32' The game is interrupted as Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) is flagged offside.
30' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
28' 1 - 0 Djibril Sidibe plays a neat ball into the path of Yann Gboho (Toulouse), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the left post! 1:0.
28' The free kick is taken short by Toulouse.
27' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Rennes is cautioned for aggressive play.

26' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Ludovic Blas (Rennes) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Guillaume Restes was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
24' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Guillaume Restes is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
22' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
20' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
18' Toulouse fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
16' Frank Magri (Toulouse) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the goal. Poor header!
14' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
14' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the right post.
12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Toulouse comes to nothing.
11' Joshua King (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It will be a corner kick for Toulouse.
10' Brice Samba displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Joshua King (Toulouse) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
7' The corner kick picks out Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
7' The ball is out of play and Toulouse manage to earn a corner.
3' Jordan James (Rennes) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Toulouse will kick the game off.
Benoit Millot was nominated as the referee for this game.
